name: La Colilla (Spain)
description: Tierced at the hoist, red with a white indented stripe, the fly red with six yellow rocks surmounted by a white star.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 12 March 2003 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 60 of 28 March 2003); the fly bears on red six yellow rocks surmounted by a white five-pointed star, the hoist tierced red with a white indented stripe.

features.role: white indented stripe at the hoist
